title.quote: Why Exposure Bias Matters: An Imitation Learning Perspective of Error Accumulation in Language Generation

extractions.description: The paper analyzes the issue of exposure bias in language generation models, attributing repetitive and incoherent outputs to error accumulation during the generation phase. It approaches this problem from an imitation learning perspective, providing a theoretical framework to analyze error accumulation and proposing metrics to quantify it. The study uses the GPT-2 model for empirical analysis, testing various decoding methods to reveal the impact of error accumulation on text generation quality.
